verdict.rationale: dlt is a data extraction/loading library, not itself an agent with a tool-use loop; the evidence shows dlt ships an MCP *server* (dlt-mcp) exposing its own pipeline tools to external coding agents, which is the opposite role from consuming external MCP servers as tools. No evidence indicates dlt acts as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to extend its own capabilities, so this client-side axis does not apply to this kind of product.
